note: Innisfail Lions Club campground at the corner of 56 Street and Lakewood Drive on the west side of Innisfail; sites for tents or trailers, playground, firewood for sale. Sani-dump tokens (C$5) for the town's RV dump stations are sold at the campground. --Claude
summary: Town page: operated by the Innisfail Lions Club, 40 sites, 15 A power, showers, potable water, reservations accepted, May 1 - Oct 15, phone 403-318-3508. Wrote season (manual), hookups 15 A (replacing derived 30), sites 40 (was 42), facilities, booking (phone); note rewritten. No rate posted. Pin sits in the cemetery south of the campground - move.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 52.03130,-113.96120 falls in the cemetery south of the Lakewood Drive junction (Esri imagery 0.62 m/px). The campground's treed loops are north of the junction, centre about 52.0335,-113.9613 (Google's 'Anthony Henday Campground' pin 52.03339,-113.96080). About 230 m - recommend the move because the stored pin is on a different site.
HOOKUPS: town page says 'Serviced sites with 15 amp electricity'; the derived 30 (from the old note's '15/30-amp') replaced with 15. SITES: page '40 sites' (derived 42 replaced).

PRICE: no rate on the town page and the club's site is gone; local (Lions on town-listed campground), so no private price gate. RV Life stored 4.5 stars, $$. Google 'Anthony Henday Campground' 4.4 stars from 133 reviews, phone +1 403-318-3508.

WEBSITE: stored https://innisfail.ca/campgrounds-parks-trails/ answered 200 and is the only live official page - keep. Google's listed site https://innisfaillionsclub.org/campgrounds answers 200 but is a parked domain (domain-parking redirect) - do not use.
PHONE: 403-318-3508 (stored) confirmed on the town page and Google.

OWNERSHIP local kept: the town lists it ('operated by The Innisfail Lions Club'); the old note's 'on Town of Innisfail land' is not stated on the page but is not contradicted, and the brief's Lions-on-town-land rule gives local.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the lake east of the campground is 50-90 m from the nearest loop across Lakewood Drive (the old Hwy 54), houses and a tree belt. The old note's 'Sits beside a small town lake' dropped from the note.

SEASON wording conflict on the page: the headline says 'Open May 1 to October 15, weather permitting'; a later line 'Open starting May long weekend with closure in September' refers to the town's sewage disposal stations. Wrote May 1 - Oct 15.
